```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set.seed(2025)
```

```{r import}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggeffects)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r}
#read in the raw data
data_path <- "../data_raw"
files <- list.files(data_path, full.names = TRUE)
raw <- files %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv, .id = "file_id")

# The experiment currently exports both verb versions; retain verb as a model factor.
required_columns <- c("type", "response", "participantID", "item", "context", "verb", "factP", "person")
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(raw))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}
if (anyNA(raw$response)) {
  stop("Missing response values found in the trial data.")
}
unexpected_filler_items <- raw %>%
  filter(type == "filler", !item %in% c(0, 2, 3, 16, 17, 18)) %>%
  distinct(item) %>%
  pull(item)
if (length(unexpected_filler_items) > 0) {
  stop("Unexpected filler item IDs: ", paste(unexpected_filler_items, collapse = ", "))
}
unknown_test_contexts <- raw %>%
  filter(
    type == "test",
    context != "None",
    !str_detect(context, regex("\\b(think|believe|know)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  distinct(context) %>%
  pull(context)
if (length(unknown_test_contexts) > 0) {
  stop("Unrecognized test contexts found: ", paste(unknown_test_contexts, collapse = " | "))
}
```
```{r}
#checking for filler correctness, first labeling whether filler is correctly responded to or not
raw <- raw %>%
  mutate(correct = case_when(
    type == "filler" & (item == 16 | item == 0) & response > 60 ~ TRUE,
    type == "filler" & (item == 17 | item == 2) & response > 60 ~ TRUE,
    type == "filler" & (item == 18) & response < 40 ~ TRUE,
    type == 'filler' & item == 3 & response > 60 ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ NA                         #non-fillers get NA
  ))
n_before <- n_distinct(raw$participantID)
n_before

#counting how many correct per participant
filler_summary <- raw %>%
  filter(type == "filler") %>%
  group_by(participantID) %>%
  summarize(
    n_fillers = n(),
    n_correct = sum(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#count up who gets excluded 
exclude_subjects <- filler_summary %>%
  filter(n_correct < 2) %>%  #less than 2 correct = fail
  pull(participantID)
exclude_subjects
#how many were excluded in total for both verbs
length(exclude_subjects)
#remove those participants from the dataset
fails_removed <- raw %>%
  filter(!participantID %in% exclude_subjects)
#how many participants are left
n_distinct(fails_removed$participantID)
```
Cleaning Data
```{r}
#remove unnecessary columns and fillers
fillers_removed <- fails_removed %>%
  filter(type == 'test')
QUD_added <- fillers_removed %>%
  mutate(QUD = case_when(
    str_detect(context, regex("\\b(think|believe)\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "weak",
    str_detect(context, regex("\\bknow\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "strong",
    TRUE ~ "None"
  ))

clean_all <- QUD_added %>%
  select(
    verb,
    response,
    factP,
    person,
    item,
    QUD,
    participantID
  )
clean_all
clean_think <- QUD_added %>%
  filter(verb == "think") %>%
  select(
    response,
    factP,
    person,
    item,
    QUD,
    participantID
  )
  clean_believe <- QUD_added %>%
  filter(verb == "believe") %>%
  select(
    response,
    factP,
    person,
    item,
    QUD,
    participantID
  )
```
Logit Transform responses 
```{r}
#creating logits for responses

clean_all <- clean_all %>%
  mutate(response_logit = log(pmin(pmax(response/100, 1e-6), 1-1e-6) / (1 - pmin(pmax(response/100, 1e-6), 1-1e-6))))

clean_all
```
Make factors correct formats and do coding
```{r}
#make sure categorical variables are factors with the correct level order
clean_all <- clean_all %>%
    mutate(
    verb = factor(verb, levels = c("think", "believe")),
    factP  = factor(factP, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("false", "true")),
    person = factor(person, levels = c(1,3)), 
    QUD    = factor(QUD, levels = c("None","weak","strong"))
  )
#sum coding
contrasts(clean_all$factP) <- matrix(c(-1, 1), ncol = 1) #false = -1, true = 1
contrasts(clean_all$person) <- contr.sum(2)    #1st = 1, 3rd = -1
contrasts(clean_all$verb) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(clean_all$verb)
#treatment coding for QUD factor with None as clear baseline
clean_all$QUD <- relevel(clean_all$QUD, ref = "None")
#clean_all$verb <- relevel(clean_all$verb, ref = 'think')

clean_all
```
Summary Statistics for All

```{r}
summary_table_all <- clean_all %>%
  group_by(QUD, factP, person) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_response = mean(response),
    sd_response = sd(response),
    n = n(),
    se_response = sd_response / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
summary_table_all

#Plotting summary stats for all, averaging across verbs

ggplot(summary_table_all, aes(x = QUD, y = mean_response, fill = factP)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_response - se_response,
                    ymax = mean_response + se_response),
                width = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  facet_wrap(~ person) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Responses by QUD, factP, and Person",
    x = "QUD",
    y = "Mean Response"
  )

# Collapse across 'person' using trial-level observations
summary_table_all_collapsed <- clean_all %>%
  group_by(QUD, factP) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_response = mean(response, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_response = sd(response, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_response = sd_response / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot ignoring 'person'
ggplot(summary_table_all_collapsed, aes(x = QUD, y = mean_response, fill = factP)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(),
           color = "black") +  # black outlines
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_response - se_response,
                    ymax = mean_response + se_response),
                width = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_fill_grey(start = 0.3, end = 0.7) +  # gray shades
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +  # light background and grid
  labs(
    title = "All Verbs",
    x = "QUD",
    y = "Mean Response",
    fill = "factP"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray85", size = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.2),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")  # add black axes for contrast
  )


```

Modeling Results
```{r}
model_full_ml <- lmer(
  response_logit ~ verb * QUD * factP * person +
    (1 | participantID) +
    (1 | item),
  data = clean_all,
  REML = FALSE
)
summary(model_full_ml)
isSingular(model_full_ml)
```
Goodness of Fit Testing
```{r}
model_noPerson <- lmer(
  response_logit ~ verb * QUD * factP  +
    (1 | participantID) +
    (1 | item),
  data = clean_all,
  REML = FALSE
)

model_noFact <- lmer(
  response_logit ~ verb * QUD * person  +
    (1 | participantID) +
    (1 | item),
  data = clean_all,
  REML = FALSE
)

model_noQUD <- lmer(
  response_logit ~ verb * factP * person  +
    (1 | participantID) +
    (1 | item),
  data = clean_all,
  REML = FALSE
)

model_noVerb <- lmer(
  response_logit ~ QUD * factP * person  +
    (1 | participantID) +
    (1 | item),
  data = clean_all,
  REML = FALSE
)

anova(model_full_ml, model_noPerson)
anova(model_full_ml, model_noFact)
anova(model_full_ml, model_noQUD)
anova(model_full_ml, model_noVerb)

# Refit the selected full model with REML for final parameter estimates.
max_model_all <- update(model_full_ml, REML = TRUE)
summary(max_model_all)
```
